# Kyoto Family Trip Visual Overview

A 6-day Kyoto plan for **2 adults + 1 child** with a **JPY 180,000** on-ground budget works best with a **comfortable, family-friendly pace**: one major area per day, short transit hops, and early evenings.

## Trip Plan by Day

### Day 1: Arrival + Gion Evening Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, rest, and buy transit IC cards.
- Afternoon: Light lunch near Kyoto Station; easy start with Kyoto Tower area.
- Food: Udon or set meals for a low-stress first day.
- Pace: **Very light**.

### Day 2: Arashiyama Nature Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Bamboo Grove early before crowds.
- Afternoon: Monkey Park or river stroll, then café break.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/ea/Iwatayama_Monkey_Kyoto.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Monkey Park or river stroll, then café break, Kyoto, Japan
- Food: Tofu dishes or soba near Arashiyama.
- Pace: **Moderate**.

### Day 3: Fushimi Inari + Central Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- Morning: Fushimi Inari Taisha, do a partial climb only.
- Afternoon: Nishiki Market and downtown shopping.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Nishiki Market and downtown shopping, Kyoto, Japan
- Food: Market snacks plus a sit-down dinner.
- Pace: **Moderate**.

### Day 4: Higashiyama + Temple Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Kiyomizu-dera area and scenic streets.
- Afternoon: Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka, then a tea or dessert stop.
- Food: Kyoto sweets, yuba, and a relaxed dinner.
- Pace: **Moderate to slow**.

### Day 5: Family Choice Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Morning: Kyoto Railway Museum or Kyoto Aquarium.
- Afternoon: Park time, souvenir shopping, or a second temple visit if energy is high.
Media: Alt=Afternoon: Park time, souvenir shopping, or a second temple visit if energy is high, Kyoto, Japan
- Food: Casual lunch and simple kid-friendly dinner.
- Pace: **Easy**.

### Day 6: Final Stroll + Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg
- Morning: Short breakfast walk and final souvenir pick-up.
- Afternoon: Check out and depart.
- Food: Quick station meal before leaving.
- Pace: **Very light**.

## Spending Breakdown for JPY 180,000

| Category | Budget | Share | Notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Lodging | JPY 78,000 | 43% | Mid-range family room or 2 rooms for 5 nights |
| Food | JPY 48,000 | 27% | Mix of breakfasts, lunches, and casual dinners |
| Local transit | JPY 14,000 | 8% | Subway/bus/occasional taxi for child comfort |
| Attractions | JPY 18,000 | 10% | Temples, museum, monkey park, small admissions |
| Snacks + drinks | JPY 10,000 | 6% | Treats, café breaks, convenience items |
| Buffer | JPY 12,000 | 7% | Weather changes, extra taxi, souvenirs |
| Total | **JPY 180,000** | **100%** | Excluding flights |

## Sightseeing Pace Recommendation

### Sightseeing
- **Recommended pace: Medium-slow**
- Plan **1 major attraction + 1 nearby stop** per day.
- Best for a child: fewer transfers, more breaks, and earlier finishes.

### Food
- **Recommended pace: Relaxed**
- Use **simple breakfasts**, **one sit-down lunch**, and **casual dinners**.
- Add snack stops so the child stays comfortable between visits.

### Transit
- **Recommended pace: Light to moderate**
- Prefer **subway, bus, and short taxi rides** over long multi-transfer routes.
- Keep walking segments short, especially on temple-heavy days.

## Day-by-Day Chart Idea

Use a simple visual chart with these columns:
- **Date**
- **Area**
- **Main Stop**
- **Transit Load**
- **Energy Level**
- **Estimated Spend**

Suggested chart structure:
- 2025-10-12 | Kyoto Station / Gion | Arrival + evening stroll | Low | Very light | JPY 18,000
- 2025-10-13 | Arashiyama | Bamboo Grove + river area | Medium | Moderate | JPY 32,000
- 2025-10-14 | Fushimi + Central Kyoto | Shrine + market | Medium | Moderate | JPY 28,000
- 2025-10-15 | Higashiyama | Kiyomizu-dera area | Medium | Moderate-slow | JPY 30,000
- 2025-10-16 | Kyoto city family day | Museum or aquarium | Low | Easy | JPY 34,000
- 2025-10-17 | Kyoto Station area | Departure day | Low | Very light | JPY 10,000

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Build calendar] https://calendar.google.com/
